properties.description: Stamp and check, refusing a graph from the future — and, since 2026-09-12 (#486, dec:the-stamp-records-enum-values-and-nothing-finer), refusing by NAME a graph that stores an enum value this binary does not know. The stamp carries node type names, edge type names, and every declared enum vocabulary keyed Type.property; property ADDITIONS are deliberately not recorded, and semantic changes are not claimed to be caught. Step 3 of flow:release-cut reads it to decide whether an upgrade note is owed: the note is owed when the stamp MOVED, which now includes a new enum value — v0.59.0 is the first such cut (Decision.status gained `deferred`), and its note warns that an OLDER binary cannot see that move and shows a deferred decision as gone. An older stamp with no enum record still opens: an absent record is not a claim.
